name: Ball smashes the square
what: A ball swings round a square in a long loop and then smashes into it: the square shatters into four shards while the ball bounces off the bottom of the frame, and the shards open into blurred, tilted chunks of a title that swing flat and sharpen.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0 a square at the centre; f4-f28 the ball swings in from the left edge and down round the bottom; f28-f58 it rises up the right side to a pause (f58-f64); f66-f76 it flicks up to the top right; f76-f92 it floats to the top; f94-f109 it dives down-left onto the square; f110 the smash: the square shatters into four shards and the ball bounces away off the bottom (f111-f127); f111-f145 the shards drift on curved paths; f146-f148 they open into three blurred, rotated chunks of the title; f148-f154 the chunks swing flat and sharpen; hold to f224
